raw_text: Stuxnet-like malware found targeting Indian chemical plant's Siemens PLCs. The malware, capable of manipulating industrial processes while hiding changes from operators, was discovered during a routine security audit. Security researchers say the code shares structural similarities with the original Stuxnet worm but uses updated techniques. India's CERT-In has issued an emergency advisory for the chemical and petrochemical sectors.
clean_text: Stuxnet-like malware found in Indian chemical plant Siemens PLCs. Manipulates processes while hiding from operators. Found during routine audit. CERT-In issued emergency advisory.
